class.name: WorldStreamer
class.brief_description: Streams the chunks of a large world in and out around a focus point.
class.description: WorldStreamer keeps only the part of a big world that is near the player in memory. The world is divided into a grid of cells of [member cell_size]. For every cell within [member load_radius] of the [member focus] the streamer looks up a scene file (using [member chunk_path_template] or a callback set with [method set_chunk_provider]), loads it on a background thread, and adds it as a child. Cells that are farther than [member unload_radius] are removed again. Loading uses [ResourceLoader] threaded requests and at most [member max_instantiations_per_frame] chunks are instantiated per frame, so walking through the world does not stall the game. A chunk scene is a normal scene: put the terrain, buildings, props and enemies of one cell in it, with the origin of the scene at the corner of the cell. The streamer moves the chunk root to the corner of its cell. [codeblock] var streamer = WorldStreamer.new() streamer.focus = ^"../Player" streamer.cell_size = 128.0 streamer.load_radius = 400.0 streamer.unload_radius = 500.0 streamer.chunk_path_template = "res://world/chunk_{x}_{z}.tscn" add_child(streamer) [/codeblock] Cells without a scene file are skipped silently, so the world may have holes (oceans, unfinished areas). Unload radius larger than the load radius gives hysteresis: a player pacing along a cell border does not make chunks flicker in and out. [b]Large worlds:[/b] when the chunks live under a [Node3D] set as [member chunk_parent] that is moved by [FloatingOrigin3D], the focus position is measured in that node's local space, so the grid stays in absolute world coordinates while the origin shifts.

method.name: cell_to_world
method.description: Returns the corner with the lowest coordinates of [param cell], in the local space of the chunk parent.

method.name: get_chunk
method.description: Returns the loaded chunk of [param cell], or [code]null[/code] if that cell is not loaded.

method.name: get_chunk_provider
method.description: Returns the callback set with [method set_chunk_provider].

method.name: get_loaded_cells
method.description: Returns the cells whose chunks are currently loaded.

method.name: get_loaded_count
method.description: Returns the number of loaded chunks.

method.name: get_pending_count
method.description: Returns the number of chunks that are being loaded in the background.

method.name: is_cell_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the chunk of [param cell] is loaded.

method.name: refresh
method.description: Updates the streaming immediately instead of waiting for [member update_interval]. If [param retry] is [code]true[/code], cells that had no scene or failed to load are tried again, for example after new chunk files were added.

method.name: set_chunk_provider
method.description: Sets a callback used instead of [member chunk_path_template] to find the scene of a cell. It receives the cell as a [Vector3i] and returns the scene path as a [String], or an empty string if the cell has no chunk. This allows chunk lookup from a database or a procedural generator.

method.name: unload_all
method.description: Frees every loaded chunk. They are loaded again at the next update while the focus is nearby.

method.name: world_to_cell
method.description: Returns the cell that contains [param position] on the streamed [member axes].

members.member: Which axes make up the grid. [constant AXES_XZ] streams on the ground plane of a 3D world, [constant AXES_XY] is for 2D worlds, and [constant AXES_XYZ] also streams along the vertical axis. Changing it unloads every chunk.

Edge length of a cell. Pick a size so that one chunk holds a reasonable amount of content: big enough that loading is not constant, small enough that a chunk loads quickly. Changing it unloads every chunk.
Node that the chunks are added to. By default they are children of the streamer. Set it to a [Node3D] or [Node2D] to control their transform, for example to move them with [FloatingOrigin3D].

Path of a chunk scene with [code]{x}[/code], [code]{y}[/code] and [code]{z}[/code] replaced by the cell coordinates, for example [code]res://world/chunk_{x}_{z}.tscn[/code]. Ignored when a provider was set with [method set_chunk_provider].
If [code]false[/code], no chunks are loaded or unloaded. Chunks that are already loaded stay.
Node whose position decides which chunks are needed, usually the player or the camera. It can be a [Node3D] or a [Node2D]. If it is empty or invalid, [member focus_position] is used.
Position used when no [member focus] node is set. Update it from a script for custom streaming points.
Cells closer than this distance (measured to the cell's box) to the focus are loaded.
Maximum number of chunks loading in the background at the same time.
Maximum number of loaded chunks added to the scene in one frame. Instantiating a large scene takes time on the main thread, so a small value keeps the frame rate steady while moving.
If [code]true[/code], the root of every chunk is moved to the corner of its cell. Turn it off if the chunk scenes are already authored at their world position.
Loaded cells farther than this distance from the focus are freed. Values below [member load_radius] are treated as equal to it.
Time in seconds between two evaluations of which cells to load and unload. Checking a few times per second is enough; [code]0[/code] checks every frame.

signal.name: chunk_load_failed
signal.description: Emitted when a chunk scene could not be loaded or instantiated. The cell is not retried until [method refresh] is called with [code]retry[/code].

signal.name: chunk_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after the chunk of [param cell] was added to the scene.

signal.name: chunk_unloaded
signal.description: Emitted when the chunk of [param cell] was removed, either because the focus moved away or because the chunk was freed elsewhere.

constants.constant: Grid on the ground plane of a 3D world; height is ignored.
Three dimensional grid; chunks are also streamed along the vertical axis.
